verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only aggregate, broadcast-level engagement data through the API: per-broadcast recipients, opens, clicks and rates [kit-docs-36], and per-link unique clicks [kit-docs-37]. Nothing documents an endpoint returning a single subscriber's history of sent, opened and clicked emails. The webhooks overview [kit-docs-21] and the pricing-page mention of engagement scoring [kit-docs-9] do not show per-contact engagement history being readable via the API.
